notes: Statewide Washington providers. Regional shards (puget_sound, spokane, etc.) take precedence for local queries. Primary VA system: VA Puget Sound Health Care System (Seattle + American Lake/Tacoma divisions). Significant active-duty and veteran population from JBLM, Bremerton Naval Base, McChord, Whidbey Island NAS. Washington State Department of Veterans Affairs (WDVA) at 1-800-562-2308.

providers.name: Washington Department of Veterans Affairs (WDVA)
providers.notes: State agency. Statewide claims assistance and benefits navigation. County VSO network across WA. Find your county VSO at dva.wa.gov.

providers.name: VA Puget Sound Health Care System
providers.notes: Two-division system. Seattle Division at 1660 S Columbian Way serves King/Snohomish/north counties. American Lake Division at 9600 Veterans Dr SW, Tacoma serves Pierce/Kitsap/south counties including JBLM veterans. Route to puget_sound shard for specific division detail.
source_hints: va.gov Puget Sound Health Care System

providers.name: Mann-Grandstaff VA Medical Center — Spokane
providers.notes: Primary VAMC for Eastern Washington. Serves veterans east of the Cascades — Spokane, Yakima, Tri-Cities, and surrounding rural areas.
verify_before_production: Mann-Grandstaff main line — check va.gov facility page

providers.name: Washington State Vet Centers
providers.notes: Multiple Vet Centers across WA. No VA enrollment required. Walk-in eligible. Use va.gov/find-locations to find the nearest one.
source_hints: va.gov vet center locator — Washington State

providers.name: Joint Base Lewis-McChord (JBLM) Transition Services
providers.notes: TAP (Transition Assistance Program) and SkillBridge for separating soldiers and airmen. One of the largest military installations in the US — robust on-base transition infrastructure. Also serves retiring 20-year veterans.
